subject: Runway alignment — OKR pulse, finalize forecast stitch & account playbooks
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runway alignment — OKR pulse, finalize forecast stitch & account playbooks

Team —

We're one week out from the leadership QBR window. I want to lock the runway numbers and the account playbooks for the top 12 deals we list in the forecast. Primary asks:

- Consolidate the forecast file (attached) into a single source of truth; highlight any >20% deltas vs. last week.
- Confirm which accounts have an active mutual action plan and whether legal/procurement timelines are gated.
- For Nimbus Analytics (RNW-3941) we need a one-page playbook with: next steps, outstanding compliance asks, and final close date estimate.

I've attached the current draft of the runway forecast and a first cut of the Nimbus playbook. Please reply with updates inline by EOD Monday (6/18). I'll synthesize and send the leadership-ready one-pager on Wednesday.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachments: runway_forecast_draft.csv (csv), Nimbus_account_playbook_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway alignment — OKR pulse, finalize forecast stitch & account playbooks

Irene —

Quick read-through and first pass comments:

- I ran a pivot on the draft CSV and flagged six accounts with changes >20%. I'll attach my annotated sheet to the drive link.
- Nimbus: sales cycle shortened from 9w to 6w if we push through the pre-signed DPA; procurement needs SOC2 attestation details — CS is pulling the evidence.
- Two asks: (1) can we lock the commit dates for deals where engineering sign-off is pending? I don't want optimistic dates in the leadership deck; (2) can Aditya confirm the discount band used for RNW-3941 (I think it's 15% but the draft shows 20%).

Onboarding note: we should include a single OKR row in the leadership slide that maps forecast health to the Q3 ARR acceleration target. I'll draft that after we see the final numbers.

—Markus

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Chen <matt.chen@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway alignment — OKR pulse, finalize forecast stitch & account playbooks

Thanks for the update, Irene/Markus.

Asha here from Nimbus — quick points from our procurement and data security leads:

- SOC2 evidence: we'll accept the single consolidated audit packet but need the encryption-at-rest documentation and KMS key lifecycle info before legal signs off. Can your security team send the redacted artifact?
- Discount: our finance model assumes a 15% introductory discount; if Redwood needs 20% to move the deal we need justification on TCO (counter-offer possible).
- Timeline: we can accelerate to close by 07/06 if procurement gets the SOC2/KMS details by 06/23 and contract terms are final by 06/28.

Forwarding our signed MS with annotations — see inline.

Regards,
Asha Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships, Nimbus Analytics
asha.patel@nimbusanalytics.com

Attachments: Nimbus_signed_MS_annotated.pdf (pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway alignment — OKR pulse, finalize forecast stitch & account playbooks

Team — consolidated summary and action items below (this is what I'll present to execs unless you push back):

1) Forecast stitching
- Finalized runway file: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-runway-qbr (master: runway_forecast_final.csv).
- Net change vs last week: +$1.2M ARR; material deltas documented in the "delta_report" tab.

2) Nimbus (RNW-3941) — status
- Current commit estimate: 2028-07-06 (accelerated if SOC2 artifacts arrive by 06/23).
- Discount band: 15% confirmed by Aditya (see HubSpot deal #3941).
- Outstanding: KMS/key rotation docs (security) and final payment terms.
- Assigned: Karthik to own procurement coordination; Markus to own exec negotiation.

3) OKR mapping
- Proposed leadership slide: "Runway health vs OKR: ARR acceleration" with three buckets (On-track / Watch / Off-track). Current top-12: 8 On-track, 3 Watch, 1 Off-track.
- Action: Aditya to provide final ARR impact numbers per account by Tue 06/25.

4) Deliverables and deadlines
- Karthik: gather SOC2/KMS artifacts and upload to shared drive by 06/23.
- Aditya: final per-account ARR delta and confirmed discount bands by 06/25.
- Markus: final notes for exec readout by 06/27.
- Irene: produce leadership one-pager and OKR row by 06/28.

If no objections, I'll lock the deck on 06/28 and circulate to the execs.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
VP, Sales Strategy & Ops, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3941
Attachments: OKR_checkpoint_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
